summary: Improved Xbox full-screen startup, handheld detection, Playnite compatibility, and update reliability.
notes: Improved Xbox full-screen experience startup reliability on handheld PCs.
Improved controller and handheld detection across different Windows devices.
Improved Xbox full-screen session entry, focus, and desktop return reliability.
Playnite now supports custom and portable installation locations more reliably.
Improved update-check behaviour and clearer update messaging.
Unified Xbox full-screen support checking in Settings.
General reliability improvements.

summary: A smoother path to Pro, more reliable account handling, and better accessibility.
notes: Upgrading to Pro is clearer: one obvious action to get Pro, and the options shown now match your account state.
If you already have a membership, CouchMode offers to refresh it instead of asking you to connect again.
Managing your membership is more complete. You can switch to a different account or release this PC at any time, and releasing a PC now asks for confirmation first.
Signing in now finishes reliably even if you close the CouchMode window while it is still in progress.
CouchMode now respects the Windows reduced-motion setting across the whole app.
Fixed the Pro badge on the custom launcher option so it opens the upgrade prompt correctly.
knownIssues: Xbox Mode availability depends on your Windows version, device support, Xbox app support, region, and Microsoft rollout status.
PlayStation controllers cannot currently start or end CouchMode sessions, because Windows does not expose their connection state through XInput.
On some handhelds and laptops a built-in controller is intentionally ignored as a session trigger, so an external controller may be required.

summary: Steam Big Picture and Playnite Fullscreen are now free, alongside the Xbox full-screen experience. Custom launchers, Resource Control and Session Tweaks remain Pro.
notes: Steam Big Picture and Playnite Fullscreen are now available without Pro, alongside the Xbox full-screen experience.
Custom launchers, Resource Control and Session Tweaks remain Pro features.
Pre-existing Steam Big Picture sessions are preserved when the CouchMode session ends.
More reliable Playnite handling: an already-open Playnite is recognised, including a minimized window, adopted instead of starting a second copy, and preserved when the CouchMode session ends.
More reliable custom launchers: better focus handling, clearer process ownership and cleaner shutdown.
Custom launchers now start in their own folder, so launchers that expect to run from their install directory work correctly.
A launcher counts as ready only when one of its real windows is in front, so the controller can actually drive it.
Improved Xbox full-screen detection across desktop PCs and Windows handhelds.
Fixed cases where supported devices could appear unsupported or ask to be verified repeatedly.
More accurate built-in and external controller detection, based on how a controller is connected rather than who made it.
Clearer messaging when Windows does not present a controller as an Xbox (XInput) controller.
More reliable Resource Control: better detection of the apps you selected, more dependable closing and reopening, and more accurate reporting of what was actually closed.
More reliable Launch on Enter, Close on Exit, Launch on Exit and Display on Exit.
Safer return to your desktop when a session ends.
Improved diagnostics and problem reporting.
General update and session reliability improvements.
knownIssues: Devices can only be released from the PC they are on; there is no in-app option to sign out of all devices.
Experimental: Xbox Full-Screen Experience depends on Windows system behavior. On some devices, controller navigation may not receive focus automatically and may require pressing the Xbox button once.

summary: Plug in a controller and Steam Big Picture, Playnite or the app you chose opens full screen; unplug it and CouchMode closes the session and brings the desktop back.
notes: Improved Xbox full-screen detection across desktop PCs and Windows handhelds.
Fixed cases where supported devices could incorrectly appear as unsupported or require repeated verification.
Improved reliability when entering, leaving, and returning from Xbox full-screen sessions.
Improved detection of built-in and external controllers, including external controllers that could be treated as integrated handheld controllers.
Improved desktop restoration after a gaming session; CouchMode now avoids unnecessarily changing windows that are already accessible.
Improved diagnostic information available with bug reports.
Improved update-state handling and general reliability.

notes: Fixed an issue that could prevent Exit from responding from the tray menu.
Improved the reliability of keeping open applications running and accessible after leaving Xbox mode.
Improved safe recovery for windows that could otherwise remain off-screen or unusable.
Improved built-in and external controller detection on handheld devices.
Improved desktop-return verification and overall session stability.
General reliability improvements.

summary: Plug in a controller and Steam Big Picture, Playnite or the app you chose opens full screen; unplug it and CouchMode closes the session and brings the desktop back.
notes: Steam Big Picture, Playnite fullscreen and a custom app of your choice are sessions CouchMode owns: they close reliably when the controller disconnects, and the desktop comes back.
The return to the desktop is verified on every exit, not assumed.
Optional Resource Control closes the apps you selected for the session and reopens them afterwards. It works from a list frozen before the session starts, so nothing you open later is ever touched.
General reliability improvements for Pro access, membership checks, and startup licensing.
Pricing, the 7-day trial, offline grace, tiers and device limits are unchanged.
